summary.intent: Ship Phase 65 (SDK Write-Chain, Bin Re-link, and Invite Claim) through the full post-execute loop: verify → secure → validate → simplify → SDK E2E gate → CodeRabbit CLI → PR creation → resolve PR reviews.
summary.outcome: Completed through Step 6 (CodeRabbit CLI produced 23 findings, triaged into clusters A/B/C + 2 deferred to Phase 68); parallel fix-wave worktree agents were being set up at transcript end. PR not yet opened.

repo: Phase 65 commit subjects use `feat(65-01):` style (not GSD's non-conventional `feat 65-01:` style), so the Step 7 filter-branch reword was unnecessary — commitlint runs on PR title only, not individual commits.
The security auditor has a known gotcha of writing to repo-root SECURITY.md instead of the phase doc; must verify it wrote `.planning/phases/<N>-*/65-SECURITY.md` after it commits.

CodeRabbit CLI findings for crypto phases are substantive: 23 findings (1 critical, 17 major, 5 minor) concentrated on zeroization gaps, fail-closed guards, input validation, tombstone-ordering, and test strengthening.

The sdk-e2e suite has pre-existing metadata-refactor type errors in non-phase-65 suites (tracked by `remigrate-filepointer-era-e2e-helper-scripts` and `upload-batch-test-mock-type-drift` todos) — these are not phase-65 regressions.
WRITE-04 live publish gate (403/410 enforcement) is intentionally deferred to Phase 66 per D-02 design; the mock seam is the designed boundary, not a gap.

65-04's `SharedWriteContext` reshape under-scoped its consumers and required a post-merge `fix(65-04)` commit touching `context.ts`, `client.ts`, `SharedFolderState`, and a Phase-68-marked web bridge.

code.finding: buildNodeAad binds childId/kind/generation with role 0x04; D-09 comment guards denial-of-service surface.
encryptBinMetadata encrypts BinEntry metadata using nodeReadKey (types.ts:72).
sealChildReadKey seals the child read key inside bin entries.
D-09 guard; reWrapKey zeros intermediate key material.
CannotWriteUntilRefetchError thrown on all write ops when stale — covers tombstoned-target case too (also lines 348, 487).
Minted keys zeroed in catch block to prevent information disclosure on error paths.
unsealNode called with nodeWriteKey for write-body reseal; write-body-reseal tests verify this path.
IPNS guard 'no valid IPNS private key' retained — fail-closed against spoofing.
Fail-closed guard for PLACEHOLDER_WRITE_KEY; zero occurrences of PLACEHOLDER_WRITE_KEY in source confirmed by grep.
Child-first ordering in rotateWriteFromNode: child published before parent re-points (prevents orphan window).
generateEd25519Keypair called per-node (not reused) for fresh write key on rotation.
sequenceNumber: 1n set on rotation to prevent IPNS replay/spoofing.
teeUnenrollFn called to unenroll revoked writer from TEE during rotation.
newWriteKey.fill(0) and privateKey.fill(0) called after rotation to zero key material.
Revoked holder gets deleteWriteGrantFn; surviving co-writers get wrapKey re-wrap.
NEVER-zeroed-by-rotateOne comment guards callerFolderKey against premature zeroization DOS.

workflow: Security auditor and CodeRabbit CLI can be run in parallel (both read-only relative to each other); Nyquist audit must be held until the security auditor commits to avoid git index.lock race.
The `SCRATCH` shell variable does not export into node subshells spawned via Bash tool — must pass paths inline or as argv rather than via env vars.
CodeRabbit CLI findings cluster naturally by code coupling (rotation domain / shared-write / primitives+bin); dispatching fix-agents per cluster avoids merge conflicts in parallel worktrees.

Deferred Phase-68 wiring items (client.ts publishedNode writeback, web bridge placeholder) should be captured as todos in `.planning/todos/pending/` before opening the PR so they appear in the PR body.
GSD ship-phase loop ordering: security commit → nyquist audit → coderabbit triage → fix-wave → PR open; skipping the ordering causes index races or premature PR with unfixed findings.

friction: The `SCRATCH` shell env variable was not visible inside node subprocesses spawned by the Bash tool, requiring two retries of the finding-parse and cluster-split commands before using inline paths.
CodeRabbit CLI review is slow (several minutes for a large diff) and must be backgrounded; no progress signal until it completes, so the assistant polled via tail of the log.
The Nyquist validation had to be deliberately delayed until the security auditor's commit landed to avoid a git index.lock race on the main worktree — adds latency to the pipeline.
The known `gh pr edit` failure on this repo (Projects-classic GraphQL) requires a workaround via `gh api -X PATCH` with a body file — easy to forget and causes a silent failure if not applied.
65-04's SharedWriteContext reshape under-scoped consumers and required a post-merge fix commit, adding complexity to the wave-2 integration.
